slice_description: Original 34-frame static Beating material kit: quiet sand, flat salt crust, solid low dune masses, sandstone floor and walls, rounded rocks, full brine and depleted-but-still-wet film, pale salt veins, bones, saltbriar and warm packed-gravel RoadStone. Existing DryBrush and Signpost art is reused. Eligible ordinary Beating surface graphs retain current map, POI, saved-lair, cached-graph, owner and state checks; six observed formations are samples, not whole-biome acceptance. No generation, gameplay or optional animation was added. Previously approved regional and portable art remains inherited.
